note: boqeq usually means "lay waste/empty", but here, followed by "yields its fruit" and increasing altars, it is generally taken as "luxuriant, spreading" (cf. Arabic); KJV's "empty" contradicts the rest of the verse.

kjv: for a present to king Jareb
mine: as tribute to the great king
note: As at 5:13, melekh yarev is the Assyrian title "great king", not a name.
